description: This file contains localization settings for the jQuery UI datepicker plugin, specifically for traditional Chinese (Taiwan). It defines various textual labels, date formats, and regional settings, and registers these settings with the datepicker library.

methods.name: define
methods.description: AMD module definition function, used to register the module if AMD is supported.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory function that initializes the regional settings for the datepicker.

methods.name: datepicker.regional
methods.description: An object holding regional configurations for different locales.

methods.name: datepicker.setDefaults
methods.description: Method to set default regional settings for the datepicker.
